title: Frame: Always print frame arrival time in Local/UTC/Unix
description:
Instead of printing frame arrival time in local time, and having
a preference to also display Epoch time, just eliminate the
preference and add fields to include all three representations,
that are all useful and complementary.

This does not warrant having a preference IMO, therefore the
existing preference is removed and declared as obsolete.
It's borderline but preferences should be reserved for something
more substantial than "add one or two extra time representations".

This uses different filter names, "frame.time", "frame.time_utc"
and "frame.time_epoch" but they are all the same value of course.

Only the field "frame.time_utc" is new.

notes.body: Seems good to me, especially since the frame fields aren't dissected anyway until the frame protocol is referenced (or the tree is visible.)
